How does shopy-science.io work? 

01

Native-Shopify 

Activate the Shopy-Science.io app directly in your Shopify store.

02

Connecting social media & services

Upon your approval, ShopyScience will connect to your Facebook account and Google Ads service.

03

Allocation

To optimize results, a sub-domain will be allocated to the Shopy-science.io data tracker. The sub-domain will be linked to the store’s digital domain.

That’s it! Your sales and marketing data analysis are now available in the app
Shopy-Science.io.

Why Shopy-Science.io ? 

1. To develop a precise knowledge of each of your customers

Who are your customers? What products do they buy in priority on your online store? What is their life time value? What’s the churn rate and online behavior?
Shopy-Science.io provides you with all the customer analysis you need to manage your marketing strategy.

2. To easily measure the ROI of all your acquisition campaigns.

What was the turnover generated by your newsletters? Which marketing levers and media are performing best? And for what budget? On the contrary, which ones are making you lose money and which ones should you do without? With the reporting tools provided by Shopy-Science.io, each acquisition campaign leads to precise analyses to help you make your decisions.

3. To allocate the right marketing budget to the right target, with the right objective

Allocating a campaign is still too often done with a wet finger. Between your email campaigns, your google Ads campaigns, Facebook and Instagram ads, your SEO actions, etc… the customer journey becomes more complex and your customer data loses relevance because of missing data. The more data you have, the more difficult it is to analyze, and the more you doubt its reliability. Shopy-Science.io is able to identify precisely each of your customers and their buying journey, to draw reliable indicators and help you to pilot your activity.

Turn your marketing data into points of growth

‍For all e-merchants on Shopify

Does Shopy-Science.io use the
CRM data of e-merchants?

Yes, and that’s what makes our analyses so powerful, because we observe the effects of marketing actions directly on your customers who consent to them.

What is the added value of
Shopy-Scinence.io compared to already available
tools like Google Analytics and Facebook Attribution?

Because they are third-party tools, Google and Facebook data trackers are not compatible with the GDPR. On the other hand, Shopy-Science.io uses a 1st party tracker that allows you to process your own data directly.

Which Ads media can be processed
with Shopy-Science.io?

Google Ads, Facebook, Instagram, Snapchat, Bing, TikTok, etc… Shopy-Science.io is compatible with all major platforms, for paid (search, shopping, ads…) and organic levers.

How accurate is the analysis provided by Shopy-Science.io?

At the finest level! We analyze each clicked link and reconstitute our AI analyses at aggregate levels (Campaign and AdSet). It is precisely thanks to this unique method that we are more accurate in our ROI/ROAS calculations.

How to make sure that Shopy-Science.io complies with the RGPD?

Like any European digital service, Shopy-Science.io is subject to the RGPD framework. We do not compromise in the face of the absolute necessity to protect data and to respect the principle of free and informed consent of the user.

What is the methodology implemented by Shopy-Science.io in the cookie-less /1st party context?

In addition to full compliance with the RGPD, we are not impacted by the new technical conditions imposed by browsers because our solution feeds on data from the Shopify ecosystem and not on browsing data. It is therefore reserved strictly for the use of the advertiser in the context of its activity as a merchant within Shopify.

What is the difference between the data offered by Shopy-Science.io and the data already available in my Shopify account?

Shopy-Science.io doesn’t just extract data from different sources – facebook, google analytics, shopify… – to present them to you. The application produces and makes available to you a set of directly actionable analyses and recommendations.

What is the added value of the analyses proposed by Shopy-Science.io compared to those already available with competing solutions?

The great strength of Shopy-Science.io is above all to be a tool for the exclusive use of e-retailers. It is designed by e-retailers, for e-retailers, with the help of data scientists, data analysts and experienced data officers.
